five_second.sells: Online certification courses in a creative, art-based coaching method (Art of Manifesting Method / Neurographica)
five_second.for_whom: coaches, therapists, healers and creative practitioners wanting a new drawing-based tool for their sessions
five_second.price_guess: somewhere between $500 and $1500 for a certification

errand.abandoned_at: Standard Certification Full Price checkout page, after entering my email - stopped there per instructions before entering any payment

features_used.moment: I clicked Courses in the nav and the Art of Manifesting Method Coaching Certification was right at the top of the list
I scrolled to the pricing section and found Standard vs Mentored tiers, each shown in both GBP and USD stacked on the same page
clicking it took me straight to a clean checkout clearly showing £997.00 GBP as the total
clicking it opened a checkout showing £282.00 GBP x 4 monthly payments plus a note explaining the installment total is higher than paying in full
I clicked it twice from two different scroll positions and both times it just snapped back to the top of the course page instead of opening a checkout
I typed my email into the Standard Full Price checkout and it was accepted cleanly with no validation errors

features_looked_for_but_missing: a currency selector or geo-detected single price instead of GBP and USD prices just stacked on the same page
a visible 'you save' comparison badge on the pricing cards themselves so I don't have to click into checkout to do the math
feature_that_most_helped_the_decision: the split-payment checkout page's plain note that installment total is higher than paying in full, which let me directly confirm Full Price (£997) beats Split Payment (4 x £282 = £1128)
feature_that_most_hurt_the_decision: the Mentored tier's Split Payment button not opening any checkout at all after two tries

friction.moment: Both £ and $ prices for the same certification were listed stacked on one page with no toggle, flag, or any indication of which currency actually applies to me

On the Standard tier's Full Price checkout, the heading correctly says 'Standard Coaching Certification £997' but the bullet list right underneath is labeled 'Mentored Certification Includes' - a mismatched tier label that made me pause and double-check I was buying the right thing
The Mentored tier's Split Payment button did nothing but reset me to the top of the page, on two separate attempts
The course page lists a start date of '25th of May' with no year, so I can't tell if that date already passed

delight.moment: The split-payment checkout page spelled out in plain language that installment payments total slightly more than paying in full, saving me from having to guess or do hidden math
The certification page laid out the program structure, modules, teachers and certification requirements in clear, organized language before ever pushing me toward payment

what_earned_it: clear, detailed program curriculum and module breakdown before any pricing was shown
explicit written disclosure that split payments cost more in total than paying in full
visible Stripe / SSL secure payment badges at checkout
trust.what_it_would_take: Fix the broken Split Payment button on the Mentored tier, correct the mismatched 'Mentored Certification Includes' text on the Standard checkout, and replace the stacked GBP/USD prices with one clear currency selector so I know exactly what I'll be charged.

brand_recall.tell_a_friend_one_sentence: It's a small, founder-led school teaching an art-based coaching method called the Art of Manifesting Method, with a coaching certification around £997 if you pay in full - just double-check which currency you're actually being charged in and watch for a glitchy button on the pricier tier.
brand_recall.product_remembered: Art of Manifesting Method Coaching Certification
